g.text: - Retrieval beats rereading at one week, in every subject tested.
- Spacing the reviews over several days adds to the effect.
> Results. Retrieval practice improved 7-day retention by 21 percentage points.
> Spacing the same study time across several days produced better recall at one month
than massing it into one session.
